# gxkit

> Agent-native review loops for creative artifacts. Write the artifact as code, `inspect` it, get problems with stable codes and exit codes, fix them, and ship — with a storyboard image as evidence.

gxkit is a shared engine (`gxcore`) plus ten domain tools. An artifact goes in;
the one that fits is chosen and run.

## Install

```sh
# the whole family behind one `gxkit` command
uv tool install "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/gxkit"

# or one tool, without installing
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/chartgx" chartgx --help
```

`chartgx` also needs matplotlib; `shadergx` needs a GL context; `framegx` needs
ffmpeg.

## One entry point

```sh
gxkit tools              # what can be inspected
gxkit inspect chart.py   # detect the artifact and route it to its tool
gxkit inspect levelgx level.py   # or name the tool explicitly
gxkit codes              # every problem code and its severity (--json too)
```

A `.gxkit.toml` up the tree can ignore a code or change its severity. Run it in
CI with the repository's reusable action (`uses: nekomario28/gxkit@vX.Y.Z`).

## Tools

- **chartgx** — matplotlib charts: truncated bar baselines, clipped or
  overlapping text, missing titles/labels/units, dual axes, unreadable pies,
  constant or clipped data. `packages/chartgx`
- **levelgx** — game levels: no spawn/goal, unreachable goal, soft-lock from a
  one-way tile, stranded items, hazards that cut the only route.
  `packages/levelgx`
- **flowgx** — state machines / flow charts: unreachable states, dead ends,
  states that can never finish, non-deterministic events.
  `packages/flowgx`
- **authzgx** — permission models / RBAC: privilege-escalation paths, cyclic
  inheritance, dangling references, dead config. `packages/authzgx`
- **depsgx** — module dependency graphs: cycles, layer violations, banned
  edges, dead code. `packages/depsgx`
- **schemagx** — relational schemas: dangling foreign keys, type mismatches,
  foreign-key cycles, dead tables. `packages/schemagx`
- **docgx** — pages / slides: text that overflows the canvas, blocks that
  overlap, text below the readable floor, out-of-order blocks. `packages/docgx`
- **protogx** — protocol state machines: deadlocks, unhandled messages, missing
  responses, unreachable states. `packages/protogx`
- **shadergx** — fragment shaders: a compile error, a black / constant / NaN
  frame, and uniforms that never reach the output. `packages/shadergx`
- **framegx** — rendered animations: a black or frozen picture, the wrong
  length, or missing/silent sound — the output a scene inspector cannot see.
  `packages/framegx`
- **gxkit** — the umbrella: `gxkit inspect <file>` detects the artifact's tool
  and runs it. `packages/gxkit`

That is the whole planned set.

`gxcore` also shares the analysis and plumbing the tools need: `graph`
(reachability, traps, shortest path, cycles), `layout` (text
small/clipped/overlapping), `loading`, `diagram` (a deterministic node-link
renderer) and `toolkit` (build a tool from three callables).

## The contract every tool shares

```sh
<tool> inspect artifact.py     # problems + storyboard, exit 1 on any error
<tool> inspect artifact.py --json
<tool> render  artifact.py -o out.png
```

- **Exit code 1** when any `error`-severity problem is found. `warn` and `info`
  never fail the build.
- **A storyboard image** with each located problem boxed and numbered.
- **Stable codes** (`truncated-baseline`, `soft-lock`, …) an agent branches on,
  never on prose.

## Install a tool

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/chartgx" chartgx inspect chart.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/levelgx" levelgx inspect level.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/flowgx" flowgx inspect machine.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/authzgx" authzgx inspect auth.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/depsgx" depsgx inspect deps.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/schemagx" schemagx inspect schema.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/docgx" docgx inspect page.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/protogx" protogx inspect proto.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/shadergx" shadergx inspect shader.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/framegx" framegx inspect clip.py
```

Needs Python 3.10+; `chartgx` also needs matplotlib and numpy.

## Develop

```sh
uv sync --all-packages
uv run pytest
uv run chartgx inspect packages/chartgx/examples/bad_chart.py      # exit 1
uv run levelgx inspect packages/levelgx/examples/softlock_level.py # exit 1
uv run flowgx  inspect packages/flowgx/examples/broken_machine.py  # exit 1
```

See [`docs/PLAN.md`](docs/PLAN.md) for goals and the roadmap, and
[`docs/agent-native-landscape.md`](docs/agent-native-landscape.md) for which
domains are still empty.
